content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the KBCNMU Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 05-10-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of KBCNMU to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by Kavayitri Bahinabai Chaudhari North Maharashtra University (KBCNMU), Jalgaon, for various contractual positions.

faq.question: Q2. What are the posts available in KBCNMU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The available positions include Director (Contract) and Temporary Assistant Professor (Contract) in subjects like Defence & Strategic Studies and History.

faq.question: Q3. How many total vacancies are announced?
faq.answer: There are a total of 4 vacancies available across different positions in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q4. What is the start date to apply online?
faq.answer: The online application process begins on 26 September 2026 for eligible candidates to submit their forms.

faq.question: Q5. What is the last date to submit the online application?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form is 05 October 2026. Make sure to complete your submission before this date.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for open category candidates?
faq.answer: Candidates belonging to the open category are required to pay an application fee of Rs. 750/-.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application fee for reserved category candidates?
faq.answer: Applicants belonging to the reserved categories need to pay a reduced application fee of Rs. 375/-.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary range for these posts?
faq.answer: The consolidated salary ranges from Rs. 35,000/- to Rs. 50,000/- per month depending on the specific post and candidate experience.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for KBCNMU Recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process primarily involves the short-listing of eligible candidates followed by a personal interview.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply online through the official recruitment portal link provided on the university website https://apps.nmu.ac.in/recruitment/.
